title: High-Order Pole-Skipping in Near-Extremal Holography
summary: We develop a systematic analytic method for studying high-order pole-skipping in near-extremal holographic black holes. In the near-extremal regime, approaching the limit $T\to0$, the near-horizon geometry develops an approximately $\mathrm{AdS}_2 \times \mathbb{R}^{d-1}$ structure; we show that the mode index $q$ labeling pole-skipping points is identified with the IR conformal dimension $Δ_{\mathrm{IR}} = q$ in the emergent $\mathrm{AdS}_2/\mathrm{CFT}_1$ correspondence, providing a concrete physical interpretation of the subleading pole-skipping tower.
